rotation.method: Unattended-run override: working set = ALL 3 core + ENTIRE 34-keyword medicine pool (37 total), no rotation subset. Rotation only sets EMPHASIS: today's 17 emphasized keywords get dedicated queries; yesterday's 17 (indices 11-27) are grouped into shared multi-keyword queries so every keyword is still covered. 10-21 published FaceSurvival/FaceAge face-photo cancer survival (Lancet Digital Health, MGB, BBC), Argus Cognitive Neurora pediatric autism FDA, Purdue/MIT generative-AI stroke rehab robot, npj neonatal pneumoperitoneum automation-bias reader study, MIT E(3)-Pose fetal brain MRI - so imaging/reader-study/FDA expansions are steered to different angles. No WebSearch used in planning.
rotation.notes: Scope per sources.json categories[medicine]._note: clinical/treatment only - trials and results, FDA 510(k)/De Novo/CE approvals, hospital/clinic deployment and care operations, diagnosis/imaging, disease-specific drug discovery (preclinical OK if a disease is named), device software, EHR/documentation, telehealth, prior-auth automation, patient safety/bias/liability. Disease-unspecified biology / protein-structure models / benchmarks belong to science - never put one story in both sections. Exclude funding/M&A/personnel, supplement ads, evidence-free wellness-app promos. SAFETY: never pick a story readable as pathogen gain-of-function or bioweapon design - swap it, do not reword. Antibiotic and vaccine queries are framed therapeutically.

WebSearch site: queries tend to return evergreen pages - use the queries above to fill gaps. (2) WINDOW: 14 days (published 2026-10-08 through 2026-10-22); verify each item's published timestamp - JAMA RSS dates are issue dates (confirm via Crossref), Korean feeds are KST without offset. (3) Follow sources.json categories[medicine]._note: patient/clinician/regulator-facing only; disease-unspecified biology goes to science, never both sections; drop funding/M&A/personnel, supplement ads, wellness promos. (4) SAFETY: no pathogen gain-of-function / bioweapon-readable stories - drop and replace, do not reword. (5) DO NOT RESUBMIT rotation.recently_published_avoid.headlines (10-21: FaceSurvival Lancet DH/BBC; Argus Neurora autism FDA; Purdue/MIT stroke rehab robot; npj neonatal pneumoperitoneum automation bias; MIT E(3)-Pose fetal MRI; plus 10-12..10-20 list) nor same-event follow-ups without a new decision/result. (6) Today's emphasis: radiology/imaging, AI drugs in trials, pathology, ambient scribes/EHR, ED triage, sepsis, device-software regulation, hospital deployments, licensing exams, Korean 의료 AI; aim for spread and at least one Korean-source item. (7) Write candidates under the key "items" (not "candidates").
